title: U5 Animals and us 词汇讲义

entries.meaning: 令人大为惊奇的；令人惊喜或惊叹的

examples.en: It is amazing for a 2-year-old child to dress himself.
examples.zh: 一个2岁的孩子自己能穿衣服真令人吃惊。

examples.en: We are amazed at his learning ability.
examples.zh: 我们对于他的学习能力感到大为吃惊。

examples.en: To our amazement, he passed the exam.
examples.zh: 令我们吃惊的是，他通过了这次考试。

entries.notes: 词族：amaze v. 使惊奇（sth. amazes sb.）；amazed adj. 感到惊讶的（修饰人），amazing 修饰物；amazement n. 惊奇，诧异

examples.en: For more information, please visit our website.
examples.zh: 更多信息，请访问我们的网站。

entries.notes: web n. 网；网状物；website = web（网）+ site（地点）

examples.en: Feeding animals is not allowed in the zoo.
examples.zh: 动物园里禁止给动物喂食。

entries.notes: 动名词作主语：Feeding animals 作主语时谓语用单数

phrases.meaning: 记得要做某事（事情还未做）
记得曾做过某事（事情已做过）
忘记要去做某事（事情还未做）
忘记做过某事（事情已做过）

examples.en: Remember to turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.zh: 离开之前记得要关灯。

examples.en: I remember turning off the lights when I left.
examples.zh: 我记得走的时候关了灯。

examples.en: Did you remember to do the shopping?
examples.zh: 你记得要去购物吗？

examples.en: I remember meeting her at a party once.
examples.zh: 我记得在一次聚会上见过她。

entries.notes: Remember to do sth. = Don't forget to do sth. 例：Remember to call your mother every day. = Don't forget to call your mother every day.

phrases.meaning: 接某人（送某人：take sb. to sp.）

examples.en: My father collects me from school every day.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每天接我放学。

examples.en: He has a collection of stamps from all over the world.
examples.zh: 他有一系列来自世界各地的邮票。

entries.notes: 词族：collection n. 收集；收藏品；collector n. 收藏家；collective adj. 集体的；共有的（make a collective decision 做出集体的决定）

examples.en: He recognised me at first sight.
examples.zh: 他第一眼就认出了我。

examples.en: She is a recognized expert in this field.
examples.zh: 她是这个领域公认的专家。

entries.notes: 词族：recognition n. 认识；识别；recognized adj. 公认的

examples.en: Though she is only 7, she can take care of herself.
examples.zh: 虽然她只有7岁，但她能照顾自己。

examples.en: You must use this instrument with great care.
examples.zh: 你必须非常小心地使用这个仪器。

examples.en: Take care when you cross the road.
examples.zh: 过马路时要小心。

examples.en: I care for my little sister when my parents are out.
examples.zh: 当我父母外出时，我照顾我的小妹妹。

entries.notes: 词族：careful adj. 小心的；仔细的 ↔ careless adj. 粗心的；carefully adv. 仔细地 ↔ carelessly adv. 粗心地；carefulness n. 仔细；慎重 ↔ carelessness n. 粗心大意

phrases.meaning: 阻止某人做某事；免于做…

examples.en: My grandfather keeps some chickens in the yard.
examples.zh: 我祖父在院子里养了一些鸡。

examples.en: The fence keeps the dog from running away.
examples.zh: 围栏阻止狗跑掉。

examples.en: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting for a long time.
examples.zh: 很抱歉让你久等。

entries.notes: keep v. 保存；饲养；保持（保持类系动词还有 stay、remain）：keep + (n.) + adj.（keep the room clean 保持房间干净）；keep (sb.) doing

phrases.text: prefer A to B = like A better than B
prefer doing A to doing B

examples.en: She prefers tea to coffee.
examples.zh: 比起咖啡，她更喜欢茶。

examples.en: I prefer to work alone.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢独立工作。

entries.notes: preference n. 偏爱；注意双写 r：preferred, preferring

entries.meaning: （与某人）和睦相处；关系良好（= get on with sb.）；（某事物）进展

examples.en: What are your neighbours like? Do you get along well with them?
examples.zh: 你的邻居们怎么样？你和他们相处融洽吗？

examples.en: How do you get along with your English studies?
examples.zh: 你的英语学习进展如何？

entries.notes: 接 sb. 表示相处；接 sth. 表示进展

entries.meaning: 标牌；指示牌；在（文件等）上签（名）；签字

examples.en: Please sign your name here.
examples.zh: 请在这儿签你的名字。

entries.notes: signature n. 签名；签字；署名

examples.en: That dog bit me in the leg just now.
examples.zh: 那条狗刚才咬了我的腿。

examples.en: Stop biting your nails!
examples.zh: 别再咬指甲了！

examples.en: I like to pet my cat gently.
examples.zh: 我喜欢轻轻地抚摸我的猫。

entries.notes: 注意双写 t：petted, petting

examples.en: The birds are pecking at seeds on the ground.
examples.zh: 鸟儿正在地上啄食种子。

phrases.meaning: 提醒/警告某人某事（尤指可能有危险或有不良后果的事）

phrases.text: warn sb. not to do sth. = warn sb. against doing sth.

examples.en: The policemen warned us of possible thieves.
examples.zh: 警察提醒我们可能有小偷。

examples.en: They were warned not to climb the mountain in such bad weather.
examples.zh: 已经劝过他们不要在那么坏的天气攀登那座山。

entries.notes: warn v. 警告，警示

entries.meaning: 含糖的；甜的 (sweeter-sweetest)；糖果（常用复数 sweets）

examples.en: Mom bought me a packet of sweets.
examples.zh: 妈妈给我买了一袋糖果。

examples.en: That music is too loud; please turn it down.
examples.zh: 那音乐太吵了，请把音量调低些。

entries.notes: 词族：loudly adv. 大声地，吵闹地；loudness n. 高声；响度，音量；loudspeaker n. 扩音器，扬声器

phrases.meaning: 发出（太多）噪音（不可数：a loud or unpleasant sound）

examples.en: The neighbours said that we were making too much noise.
examples.zh: 邻居说我们发出了太多噪音。

examples.en: I heard a loud noise and ran to the window.
examples.zh: 我听到一声巨响，跑到了窗户前。

entries.notes: 词族：noisy adj. 吵闹的，发出噪声的（noisier-noisiest）；noisily adv. 吵闹地

phrases.text: What's the meaning of sth.? = What does sth. mean?

phrases.meaning: 对某人而言意味着什么

examples.en: What do you mean by that strange look on your face?
examples.zh: 你脸上那种奇怪的表情是什么意思呀？

examples.en: Money means nothing to him.
examples.zh: 金钱对他来说是无所谓的。

examples.en: I had meant to go running this morning, but I overslept.
examples.zh: 我本打算今天早上去跑步，但我睡过头了。

examples.en: Dieting also means being careful about which food you buy.
examples.zh: 节食也意味着要留意你买的食物。

entries.notes: mean v. 意思是；打算（meant-meant）；mean adj. 卑鄙的，刻薄的（Don't be so mean to your classmates. 不要总是对你的同学那么刻薄）；meaningful adj. 富有意义的；意味深长的（a meaningful debate / a meaningful look）；meaningless adj. 无意义的，无价值的

entries.meaning: 大声说；叫（不用于被动语态）

examples.en: He shouted to me that the boat was sinking.
examples.zh: 他向我大声喊叫说船要沉了。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, our sports meeting will be held next week.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们的运动会就下周举行。

examples.en: If the car doesn't come, we will miss the plane.
examples.zh: 如果车还不来，我们就会错过飞机。

entries.notes: if 引导的条件状语从句："主将从现"——主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时

entries.meaning: 能；会（can 的过去式，表示过去的能力）；表示委婉语气

examples.en: He could write poems when he was ten.
examples.zh: 他十岁时就会写诗了。

examples.en: Could you do me a favor?
examples.zh: 你可以帮我一个忙吗？

entries.notes: could 在疑问句中表示委婉语气，此时没有过去式的意思

examples.en: I keep a diary every day.
examples.zh: 我每天写日记。

entries.notes: 形近词辨析：dairy /ˈdeəri/ n. 奶制品——diary（日记）和 dairy（奶制品）只是字母顺序不同

examples.en: The teacher directs the students to the hall from the classroom.
examples.zh: 老师把学生从教室带到了礼堂。

examples.en: He is walking in the direction of the bedroom.
examples.zh: 他朝着卧室的方向在走。

entries.notes: 词族：direction n. 方向；direct adj. 直接的 ↔ indirect adj. 间接的

examples.en: Glad to see you!
examples.zh: 很高兴见到你！(= Nice to meet you.)

examples.en: I can hardly believe it.
examples.zh: 我几乎不敢相信。

examples.en: They don't believe in marriage.
examples.zh: 他们不相信婚姻。

examples.en: Believe it or not, pets are loyal to their owners.
examples.zh: 信不信由你，宠物是忠于它们的主人的。

examples.en: It is believed that dogs are friendly to humans.
examples.zh: 人们认为狗狗对人类很友好。

entries.notes: 词族：belief n. 相信；信念（复数 beliefs）；believable adj. 可信的；unbelievable adj. 不可信的，难以置信的

examples.en: She has become forgetful these years.
examples.zh: 近年来她变得十分健忘。

entries.notes: 反义词：forgettable adj. 易忘的；forgetful adj. 健忘的

entries.meaning: 光滑的；平坦的；平整的；平稳的

examples.en: The silk scarf feels smooth.
examples.zh: 这块丝巾摸起来很光滑。

examples.en: The plane made a smooth landing.
examples.zh: 飞机平稳降落。

entries.notes: smoothly adv. 平稳地；光滑地

examples.en: Dogs are friendly to humans.
examples.zh: 狗狗对人类很友好。

entries.notes: 词族：friend n. 朋友；friendship n. 友谊

entries.meaning: 骑马；驾驶；骑车 (rode-ridden-riding)；乘骑旅行；搭乘旅行

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to the station?
examples.zh: 我可以搭你的便车去车站吗？

examples.en: It's a 15-minute ride from my home to school.
examples.zh: 我从家到学校骑自行车15分钟。

entries.notes: 对路程提问：How far is it from your home to school? 从你家到学校有多远？
